info.title: Carina
info.description: The HTTP surface of the app process. Three contract surfaces do not fit a request/response schema and are absent from this document: the transport stream (`/sessions/{id}/stream` on the driver socket), the event hub (`GET /api/events`) and the bulk programme guide (`GET /api/programs/bulk`).
